_note: A canonical pose is keyed by ROLE (not bone), as local Δ-quaternions relative to the roleProfile's reference rest (F4/F11/F12). It applies to ANY character via that character's roleMap, using the bind-pose-relative transfer (F4) + optional IK for grips/contacts (F5/F13). Rotations below are ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders — real ones are authored visually in the editor and exported. The combat key-pose set under _library is grounded in the combat-craft KB (attack beats: anticipation -> active/hit -> follow-through -> recovery).
name: guard

ikGoals._note: optional end-effector pins, solved per-character after rotation transfer (F5/F13). Use for weapon grip + foot plant. space: 'role' = relative to the character root.

_library._note: the canonical combat key-pose set to author in the editor (combat-craft KB). Each names its beat + the roles it emphasizes; quaternions filled at authoring time.

guard.beat: defensive ready; weapon raised, weight centered

anticipation.beat: wind-up; pull back to telegraph the strike (the beat that sells weight)

strike.beat: active/hit frame; the clearest, most-exaggerated pose; weapon at contact

recovery.beat: follow-through settling to an idle-compatible end

hurt.beat: stagger/recoil; full-body lean away from impact
